rule: A capability is complete only when a workflow, an implementation or a verifiable output exists. A markdown rule on its own is 'partial'.

capabilities.evidence: pilots/01-chandlery/EVIDENCE.md, pilots/02-foundry/EVIDENCE.md, pilots/03-cask-console/EVIDENCE.md
capabilities.rationale: Upstream states the principle in prose. SiteSmith produces EVIDENCE.md per project with seven required sections and an inferred/needed marker convention the production gate reads.

SiteSmith records a signature in DIRECTION.md but until direction-fidelity gained signature-selector there was no way to show the signature existed on the page. The selector is now required and none of the three pilots declares one.
capabilities.evidence: P0-2 — all three pilots currently FAIL on 'names no signature-selector'

capabilities.rationale: No competitor requires or measures three structurally different comps. SiteSmith requires pairwise difference on three of five macro axes including composition and two of four visual-grammar fields, then verifies the rendered DOM.
capabilities.evidence: tools/gate-fixtures.mjs — macro directions sharing one visual grammar FAIL; palette variants and declared/rendered drift also FAIL

capabilities.rationale: SiteSmith v2.2 records visual density, motion intensity and aesthetic boldness as visible 1–10 values in BRIEF.md and DIRECTION.md. The values are passed into candidate formation and change which direction ranks first; they are no longer a hidden preset.
capabilities.evidence: tests/gates/search_v3_test.py proves quiet, kinetic and dense dial contracts choose different first candidates; tools/test-direction-format.mjs proves the documented dial record is parsed and validated
capabilities.licence: MIT, attributed in NOTICE.md; principle adapted, text not copied

capabilities.rationale: Upstream states anti-slop as guidance. SiteSmith keeps one append-only user-level history storing measured render fingerprints beside declared axes and visual grammar. It also blocks the measured round-8 SiteSmith recipe before any history exists.
capabilities.evidence: tools/test-direction-history.mjs plus 18 search anti-repeat fixtures in tools/gate-fixtures.mjs; all three actual round-8 pages are rejected against an empty ledger

capabilities.rationale: SiteSmith has an asset manifest but no step that inventories an existing brand — extracting palette from a supplied logo, recording type, and building a reference board. A CEO with an existing brand cannot hand it over. Closed in the rebuild: the brand step already asked what exists and the asset manifest already tracked what was missing, but nothing could make the missing thing, so "designed out" became the standing answer and three pilots in a row were carried by type and one line drawing. The engine is provider-neutral by capability, hardcodes no MCP tool name, prefers real supplied material over generation, and holds the e-commerce product-truth rule.
capabilities.evidence: 13 fixtures in tools/gate-fixtures.mjs under the visual gate, all against the mock provider: provider ladder and routing, the plan contract (missing field, third attempt, bad strategy, planned-but-unlisted), and the record contract (remote link, wrong hash, approved without QA, synthetic presented as stocked, generated not marked synthetic, baked text).

capabilities.rationale: ASSET-MANIFEST.md records id, source, licence, state, focal point and treatment; the production gate fails a build with any row not ready, an unmanifested asset, or an empty element used as a mark.
capabilities.evidence: 6 production fixtures in tools/gate-fixtures.mjs

capabilities.rationale: 'ready' means technically present. direction-fidelity now measures asset share of the first screen against what the declared imagery commits to, and all three pilots fail it (2.06 %, 4.47 %, 0.55 %).
capabilities.evidence: docs/v2/PILOT-CONVERGENCE.md

capabilities.rationale: Vendored under MIT and kept, but deliberately demoted: SiteSmith writes the contract from the winning comp rather than generating it from a query, because generating tokens before a direction is chosen is the mechanism that made nine subjects converge.
capabilities.evidence: token-drift.mjs PASS on all three pilots, 0 undeclared values
capabilities.licence: MIT, © Next Level Builder, attributed in NOTICE.md

capabilities.rationale: Upstream returns the top three by BM25, which are near each other by construction. SiteSmith adds --candidates: three deliberately contrasting rows with confidence, the near-misses they displaced and cross-project anti-repeat.
capabilities.evidence: 18 python fixtures in tests/gates/search_v3_test.py
capabilities.licence: MIT base vendored and attributed; selection logic original

capabilities.rationale: The product pipeline now detects Next.js, React/Vite and Astro from package.json, records one .sitesmith/STACK.md contract and reads only that adapter during implementation. The remaining bundled stacks are searchable but not yet auto-detected, so the broader capability remains partial.
capabilities.evidence: tools/test-product-flow.mjs proves Next.js outranks React, Astro outranks its React integration, React/Vite selects react.csv, and one stack contract is written

capabilities.rationale: impeccable's live mode edits a running page; it does not assert that a state is reachable. SiteSmith requires a Playwright journey per surface asserting a change, an announcement, a failure path and a keyboard path.
capabilities.evidence: 3 journey fixtures; a painted-state page fails, a wired one passes

capabilities.rationale: verify.mjs renders at three widths, runs axe in both colour schemes, and checks overflow, dead links, console errors, document structure and wide-font stress.
capabilities.evidence: CI: nine benchmarks, the block harness and the gallery; the control must keep failing

capabilities.rationale: SiteSmith has tools/conformance.mjs with a ratchet, but it is text-level and runs over files rather than a rendered page. impeccable's detector runs in the browser against computed style.
capabilities.evidence: conformance baseline with 97 recorded violations and a ratchet
capabilities.licence: Apache-2.0; implement independently, do not lift rules

capabilities.rationale: The product audit performs one screenshot critique after technical verification. The stricter two-reviewer, hash-lock and sealed-key ceremony remains complete as benchmark-lab machinery and is deliberately excluded from an ordinary customer-site build.
capabilities.evidence: 11 critique fixtures in tools/gate-fixtures.mjs

capabilities.rationale: PIPELINE.json declares one default journey — init, build, audit — plus the targeted harden, polish and doctor commands. Provider packs are generated from this source rather than maintained by hand.
capabilities.evidence: tools/test-product-flow.mjs asserts the default journey and generated Codex pack, including that shape and lab-only portfolio diversity do not leak into it
capabilities.licence: Apache-2.0; the idea of metadata-as-data is adopted, the file is not copied

capabilities.rationale: bin/sitesmith.mjs implements install, update and doctor, installs pinned Playwright/axe dependencies and verifies resolution in the exact target instead of borrowing the repository's node_modules.
capabilities.evidence: GitHub job 'a clean install can run the gates' starts from an empty directory, launches Chromium, runs axe and requires doctor to agree

capabilities.rationale: The installer generates Claude, Codex and Cursor entry points from PIPELINE.json and copies the same canonical skill into each provider's expected location. Lab-only steps are filtered out of generated packs.
capabilities.evidence: tools/test-product-flow.mjs generates a Codex pack and verifies its default journey and product/lab boundary; clean-install CI verifies the Claude location

capabilities.rationale: A live browser session that injects into a running dev server, stores sessions, applies manual edits and commits them is a product in itself — ~17 modules plus adapters for Svelte, SvelteKit and TanStack. It does not serve the closed loop SiteSmith is claiming, and building a worse version of it before v1.0 would cost the release. Revisit after v1.0.
SiteSmith has references/06-redesign-audit.md and a REDESIGN route, but the v2 pipeline is written for a new build; there is no step that inventories an existing component library and reuses it.
capabilities.evidence: benchmarks/06-redesign before/after pair
capabilities.licence: original (upstream redesign-skill was removed for unverifiable provenance)

capabilities.rationale: No competitor benchmarks its own effect. SiteSmith retains a harness with a pinned base digest, internal network, exact-host egress proxy, two gates and 63 self-tests, but the proposed 18 paid generations were retired before generation, so no comparative claim is made.
capabilities.evidence: 63 runner self-tests pass; probe and generations not yet run

capabilities.rationale: Mode E and the pilot enforce honest figures by convention — the chandlery publishes batch numbers and refuses to state a safe working load. Nothing mechanical stops a build inventing a price, a review or a delivery promise.
capabilities.evidence: production-gate blocks fabricated-proof language and stand-in identifiers; no check for invented commerce facts
